title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES SUSPENDING THE COLLECTION OF IRRIGATION CHARGES IN EXCESS OF SIX PESOS PER HEC- TARE FOR A PERIOD OF ONE YEAR.

text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
by order the suspension for a period of one year of the
collection of irrigation charges in excess of P6 ir. the irri-
gation systems constructed under the provisions of Act No.
2152, as amended, and operated and inaintained by the Di-
rector of Public Works, with the exception of the San Mi-
guel Irrigation System in Tarlac Province.
Paragraph 8 of Executive Order No. 161, dated August
23, 1938, as amended by Executive Order No. 8, dated July
22, 1916, is hereby amended accordingly.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of June, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-eight,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the second.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
17789
By the President:
EMILIO ABELLO
Executive Secretary
